title: BOLT: Universal Classifier Training via a Bayes-Error Upper Bound
abstract: arXiv:2501.07754v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This work introduces a novel approach to compute a universal upper bound on the Bayes error rate (BER) from classifier-output samples, which serves as a Bayes-error-related performance criterion for the underlying classification task. We show that the bound is tight in the binary case and characterize the max-sum gap that appears in the aggregate multiclass formulation. Based on this bound, we define a new loss function, called Bayes optimal learning threshold (BOLT), for training parameterized classifiers. For each data sample, the BOLT loss computes a term whose expectation upper-bounds the Bayes error, so that during training the model parameters can be updated toward minimizing this bound. Numerical experiments with both synthetic and real-world datasets show that, in the reported settings, BOLT training often attains lower held-out classification error than cross-entropy training.

translated_title: BOLT：基于贝叶斯误差上界的通用分类器训练
translated_abstract: 本工作提出了一种新颖的方法，用于从分类器输出样本计算贝叶斯错误率（BER）的通用上界，该上界可作为底层分类任务的与贝叶斯误差相关的性能评估准则。我们证明该上界在二分类情况下是紧的，并刻画了多分类聚合形式中出现的最大-和间隙。基于此上界，我们定义了一种新的损失函数，称为贝叶斯最优学习阈值（BOLT），用于训练参数化分类器。对于每个数据样本，BOLT损失计算一项，其期望值是贝叶斯误差的上界，因此在训练过程中可以朝着最小化该上界的方向更新模型参数。在合成数据集和真实数据集上的数值实验表明，在所报告的设置中，BOLT训练往往能比交叉熵训练取得更低的留出集分类错误率。
tldr: 本文提出了一种从分类器输出样本计算贝叶斯错误率通用上界的新方法，并据此定义了BOLT损失函数用于训练分类器，实验表明其往往比交叉熵训练取得更低的分类错误率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel approach to compute a universal upper bound on the Bayes error rate from classifier-output samples and defines the BOLT loss function for classifier training, which often achieves lower held-out classification error than cross-entropy training.
